note: SCOPE. Filipino restaurants, bakeries, canteens and counters in Greater London. Collected 22 September 2026. There is no Filipino restaurant award in Britain, but Michelin does reach the topic: Donia holds a Bib Gourmand in the 2026 Great Britain & Ireland guide, which is the one tier-A citation here. guide.michelin.com is listed under blocked.permanent403 in data/sources.json and that is wrong - it answers plain curl with NO user-agent header and returns HTTP 202 with an empty body to a Chrome one. Reddit is blocked, so tier E is empty; the social floor with an award is two independent voices and this pass carries sixteen, all YouTube.

sources.name: MICHELIN Guide - London Filipino restaurants, 2026 Great Britain & Ireland
sources.note: TIER A, and the only judged verdict in the topic. Michelin's Filipino filter for London returns exactly two restaurants. The three other cards on the same page are the 'nearby' rail rather than results and are NOT recorded: MRBL is Meats and Grills in Leadenhall Market, Bar des Pres - Mayfair is Asian Influences, and AO by Daniel Rogan is in Southampton (traps 12 and 15). Fourteen further Filipino venue slugs were tried on the same site and every one 404s - Ramo Ramen, Kasa and Kin, Panadera, Turo Turo, Bintang, Rapsa, Cirilo, Sarap, Kamayan, Lutong Pinoy, Apo, Kilig, Mamasons and Kuya Fernando are not in the guide at all. READ IT WITH PLAIN CURL AND NO -A FLAG; a Chrome user agent gets 202 and an empty body.

quotes.Donia: BIB GOURMAND, 2026 MICHELIN Guide Great Britain & Ireland - 'good quality, good value cooking'. Cuisine: Filipino. 'Crisp adobo mushroom croquetas are a must, as are the succulent chicken Inasal and the lechon (suckling pig) served with a lovely liver and peppercorn sauce. Bring friends, ignore the slightly testing acoustics and share the love.'
quotes.Belly Bistro: RECORDED AS 'BELLY'. Listed in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide with a Plate - no Bib and no star - and tagged 'Inspectors favorite'. Cuisine: Filipino. 'Do you go for the signature cod pandesal or the fabulous scallops Bicol Express? Wagyu picanha or seafood calderata? ... Finish with the unusual-sounding but utterly joyous frozen custard profiterole with salty fish sauce caramel.'

sources.name: Eater London - The Best Filipino Restaurants in London
sources.note: Updated 10 October 2022 and the widest single list in the set. Eater London stopped publishing in February 2023, so it is the oldest source here: of its fourteen names, Romulo Cafe has since closed and Sarap has no permanent site. Recorded as published; the article carries only the ones still trading.

quotes.Bintang: Its pandesal sliders - a starter that feels like a main - are made from short rib patties, smashed on the grill with toyomansi, a condiment of soy sauce and calamansi
quotes.Sarap: Lechon is reimagined into crispy pork trotter, stuffed with lemongrass and truffled adobo pork rice, while larger groups can literally go the whole hog and order a pig
quotes.Panadera: The highlight is the corned beef hash sando, wrapped in bechamel sauce and turned into a Filipino-style croquette
quotes.Ramo Ramen: Ramo's award-winning oxtail kare kare ramen takes inspiration from the classic Filipino dish using peanut beef broth and pulled oxtail
quotes.Filishack: The chicken is marinated in lemongrass, ginger, vinegar and calamansi before being charred
quotes.Turo Turo: RECORDED AS 'Turo Turo @ Manor of Walworth' - the residency on the first floor of a Walworth Road pub, before the Tooting Broadway restaurant. A four-hour braised pork tocino rice bowl, from the mind of Rex de Guzman
quotes.Kuya Fernando: Doubling as a restaurant and grocery store... arroz caldo, ginger-infused rice served with Filipino fried chicken and a boiled egg
quotes.Cirilo Filipino Kainan: the highlight is any of its three variations of sisig: pork, chicken or beef - all equal parts tangy and spicy, served on a sizzling plate
quotes.Kamayan sa Earl's Court: RECORDED AS 'Kamayan Sa'. A boodle fight in which crunchy fried pork knuckles, deep fried pork belly and stewed chicken are bunched together with soft rice and laid out on banana leaves
quotes.Rapsa: RECORDED AS 'Rapsa @ 100 Hoxton'. Chef Francis Puyat specialises in kinilaw - a native method of cooking using liquid fire from vinegar or citrus
quotes.Luto by Mary San Pablo: A supper club rather than a restaurant, recorded as published and deliberately not carried on the page
